name: clipring
description: Kill ring for the prompt box: cut lines into a history pane and paste them back. Key syntax: modifiers ctrl, alt (option), shift joined with +, then the key (a letter, backspace, up, down, left, right).

cut.title: Cut key
cut.description: Cuts the selection, else the cursor's line (its newline too); the cursor lands at the end of the line above, and cuts in a row merge into one clip.

paste.title: Paste key
paste.description: Pastes the selected clip at the cursor.

pane.title: Pane key
pane.description: Opens or closes the full list (also /clips).

help.title: Help key
help.description: Opens or closes the help pane.
